main.description: A current member of Congress and the money funding their campaigns over the dataset's election cycles. The record key is the member's bioguide id (e.g. 'C000127').

bioguide.description: Biographical Directory of the US Congress id; also the record key.

district.description: House district; 0 for at-large seats. Absent for senators.

accounts.description: Bluesky accounts matched to this member.

totals.description: Campaign totals reported to the FEC, by cycle.

sectors.description: PAC contributions by sector (id is the sector), largest first.

organizations.description: PAC contributions by organization (fyi.contributions.organization record key), largest first, top 50.

committees.description: PAC contributions by FEC committee id (fyi.contributions.committee record key), largest first, top 50.

contributors.description: Top contributors, counted by organization: its PAC money plus donations from people who list it as their employer. Top 50.

combinedSectors.description: Sectors from PAC and individual money combined (id is the sector), largest first.

uri.description: The fyi.contributions.account record for this account.

cycleTotals.description: Totals from the FEC's candidate summary for one cycle, in US dollars.

pac.description: From PACs and other non-party committees.

itemized.description: Individual contributions the campaign committees itemized (over $200 a year from one donor), from the FEC's committee summaries.

unitemized.description: Individual contributions reported only as a total ($200 or less a year from one donor): small donors.

outside.description: Independent expenditures for and against this member: committees' processed reports, their 24/48-hour notices dated after the last processed report, and Form 5 filings by groups and people that aren't political committees.

spenders.description: By spender (FEC committee id), largest first, top 25.

opponents.description: Independent expenditures on this member's opponents: candidates in the same race (same-party, in a primary). 'support' is money spent supporting an opponent, 'oppose' money spent opposing one. Kept apart from 'outside', which only counts spending that names the member.

spenders.description: By spender (FEC committee id), largest first, top 25.

support.description: US dollars spent supporting this opponent.

oppose.description: US dollars spent opposing this opponent.

employers.description: By the employer donors listed, largest first.

sectors.description: By the employer's estimated sector (id is the sector).

places.description: Itemized individual donations by where the donor lives, from the address on each donation.

inState.description: US dollars from donors in the member's state.

unknown.description: US dollars with no usable state.

inDistrict.description: House members with a district: the part of inState from inside it, estimated from ZIP codes. A ZIP that crosses district lines is split by land area (Census Bureau 119th Congress ZCTA relationship file).

electioneering.description: Electioneering communications (FEC Form 9) that named this member: broadcast ads shortly before an election that don't say vote for or against, so they're kept apart from 'outside'. Where an ad named several candidates, this is the member's share as the FEC calculates it.

spenders.description: By filer (fyi.contributions.committee record key), largest first.

bundling.description: Contributions registered lobbyists and lobbyists' PACs bundled for this member's campaign or leadership PAC, as the committees reported on FEC Form 3L.

committees.description: FEC ids of the committees that reported the bundles.

id.description: The lobbyist PAC's FEC committee id, or a slug of the lobbyist's name and employer.

employer.description: Lobbyists: the firm or registrant they work for, as filed.

organization.description: fyi.contributions.organization record key, where the PAC or the lobbyist's employer matches by exact name.

filings.description: FEC file numbers of the Form 3L reports listing it, newest first.

organization.description: Matching fyi.contributions.organization record key, if any.

id.description: fyi.contributions.organization record key, or 'employer:<name>' for employers without a PAC.

uri.description: The fyi.contributions.organization record, if there is one.

pacs.description: US dollars from the organization's PACs.

individuals.description: US dollars from people listing it as their employer.
